title: Tracer 9 GT+ Radar (Stealth Edition)
description: Positioned for riders seeking dedicated Urban Roadster capability, the Yamaha Tracer 9 GT+ Radar (Stealth Edition) delivers muscular mid-range acceleration paired with effortless city maneuvering. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against its responsive chassis architecture, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. With a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort and a balanced Upright Neutral layout, it maintains ergonomic composure across extended highway and city riding.
